Well they dropped the charges because as many of you guys know
the Supreme Court has been very clear over the last year that these orders violated the First Amendment
this is a religious freedom case and they violated the First Amendment because they discriminate against religion
the county as long as well as the state of California allowed a lot of essential businesses or business businesses that they deemed essentials to stay open
but not this church and that's why the appeals court ultimately overturned the fines
is because they had to follow the Supreme Court
Now pastor the legal battles are not over yet
the county is still trying to enforce a 2.8 million dollar fine
what do you expect?
Well if it's jail time I'm ready for whatever
honestly I'm not wanting to fight the county
I think that they just don't understand the Constitution
and you know the Bible says to render the Caesar the things that are Caesar's
and in America we should render the Constitution the things that are the Constitution
so those that are in leadership those that are in you know an office
they should respect the Constitution just like we are
you know I haven't changed anything I've been doing for 20 years
and we love the county and those lawyers everyone you know in this country
it's like we are you know better more united than being separated
so the fees and all that I haven't honestly I haven't thought about
Yeah I mean Mariah we're at such a political divide in our country
we need church more than ever and we need God
he just wanted to have a church service and now he's being fined all of this money
thankfully some of it was dropped but not all of it not yet at least
what do you think about them focusing on this?
I mean the pandemic where it started three years ago
we're so it's everything's so different now and he just wanted to have church
there's so many other issues that are really ailing and hurting California right now
and they're focused on this?
Yes you know I think this case is about pride at this point
even the federal judge in our case has urged the parties to settle in the county
so this is a case about pride they know that their orders were unconstitutional
the Supreme Court has specifically admonished Santa Clara County
the reality is is they just want to make a statement of Pastor Mike
because Pastor Mike defied the orders didn't cave in you know they this county has levied more fines
than against businesses and entities than any other county a lot of businesses had to pay those fines
so there is going to be political ramifications when Pastor Mike does not have to pay these fines

you know in our country we have lost the focus of what we were founded on
you know you look at what's going on in the world today and the church has always been included
especially in our county and in this country we need a great awakening you know hope comes from Christ
he's the one who died for us the governor didn't die for us the county didn't die for us
when you look at the reality of what Christ has done in people's lives and can do again in this generation
we need a great awakening so whatever comes from the county I'm not care I don't care about that
what I care about is the gospel the good news of Jesus Christ gets out to a hurting and dying world
that's the answer to all of the things that are going on and it's like they're wanting to mute that
so that you know you look at the past countries in the world the communist countries where they stop religion first

it's true Americans and physicians like myself have progressively lost their confidence in the multi-billion dollar agency
you know from these erratic yet dictatorial recommendations on contagion control vaccination and the lack of not only data transparency but data analyses
the CDC and FDA owed America a monthly data analysis on safety of the vaccines they should have had external day safety monitoring boards in place
they should have external oversight in multiple aspects of the agency and I completely agree everybody needs to go
and we need to install regular and rigorous oversight from Congress and the Senate
now Dr. Harvey Risch who's retiring from Yale this weekend is a big party for him I'm gonna be phoning in

and epidemiologic incompetence of what's at the heart of all of this
how could the CDC gets so much science so wrong with this lame apology whatever this qualifies as Dr. McCullough
yeah I think a big problem was all the social distancing they were doing themselves you know they weren't meeting
they were trying to do work by WebEx for a couple years the CDC is full of wonderful and talented physician scientists
but they they got into a direction that went horribly wrong and I think we do need to do a deep post-mortem on what happened with the agency
well they basically the new another report that just came out on August 19th
it basically implies that the mandates that they put out based on this two dose you know vaccine are were useless
that the boosters themselves wane in efficacy over time so there is a limited value limited duration value of all of this
but again people are still following Dr. Bhattacharya this original guidance on the vaccines as if they reduce transmission
but the CDC is implicitly admitting now that they don't stop transmission of the virus that was the entire basis of the vaccine mandates were they not
and still going on for the CMS and for you know healthcare facilities all over the United States and schools and colleges
yeah I mean I think that the CDC has caused untold harm by basically forget about not actually acknowledging the scientific fact that the vaccine doesn't stop transmission

it's absolutely destroyed confidence in public health and and you know I think it's also had this knock on consequence of reducing public trust in public other vaccines
vaccines vaccines that are actually quite important for public health I think is a complete disaster it's not enough just to apologize or to acknowledge wrongdoing
no
it's just that there needs to be a fundamental overhaul

I mean that's border that's borderline malpractice in my view

the doctors have clearly drunk the Kool-Aid on the vaccines I think the doctors actually are a big part of the problem of this this kind of negative legacy effect we've had on the failed vaccine program doctors really need to come in line the CDC has basically said a vaccinated person is completely indistinguishable from an unvaccinated person right we need to drop these mandates and do a thorough review of what the vaccine is

do you see it that way?
